warnings: 1 active notice(s) start after the spend window ends. They stay in the matching set (active = end date on/after window start or blank) but are not 'live' for spend_vs_award.

Publication years with kept notices below half the median (19.0) per year: 2021=7, 2026=5. Published range is 2021-02-23 to 2026-09-09, so first/last years may be partial; a thin year may also mean notices published elsewhere or an export limit. Completeness review required.
contracts.caveat: contracts.csv holds published *notices*, not a contract register. It holds awards published on Contracts Finder in roughly the last five years. A contract awarded earlier (e.g. long-running waste or highways contracts), one advertised only on Find a Tender, a framework call-off recorded under another buyer, or an exempt placement will have no notice here. "No notice found" is therefore an indicator to check against the council's contract register, never evidence of off-contract spend.

buyer_matching.normalisation: strip and collapse whitespace, then casefold
buyer_matching.comparison: exact identity only; no substring or fuzzy matching
buyer_matching.guide_interpretation: Case and whitespace are spelling variants of the two named council identities. This includes the uppercase spelling shown in the guide Setup replay.

contracts.active_definition: End date on/after spend window start, or blank end date (guide's notice-coverage proxy).
contracts.thin_year_rule: a publication year (kept notices) below half the median across years in the published range
